title: Plek
body:
Description.

Plek is a variation of kelp which can be found in the river caves.

Requires a Refined Axe or greater.

Requires a Refined Scooba Tank.

Obtaining

Plek is located deep inside of the River Caves. It is accessible of one route as of 2024.

  • Go into the magma caves and pass the magma trees
  • Go left instead of the usual straight or right for magmite
  • Fall off and go to the bottom where the magma is (You can also follow a certain route that is very complex and is the way you will haft to take up regardless)
  • Once you fall off, press V and travel further down the cave whilst navigating over magma as fast as possible
  • You have made it to the cave!

Trivia

  • Plek is the first tree in the game to be translucent.
  • surprisingly, to how Oobmab was named, Plek is actually not like Kelp spelled in reverse.
  • Plek shares some similarities with Cavecrawler Wood from Lumber Tycoon 2, such as being located in a maze, and having a similar color scheme.
